g.text: Annual education spending per student (log scale)
Rural Sindh: half of students cost households under Rs 4,500 a year, but the top tenth spend over Rs 15,500
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person file. Sample: students (ed_total > 0) in Sindh rural, n = 1440. Weighted by hhweight. 1 students outside Rs 100 to Rs 1,000,000 excluded.
